description: The signed-in person's time with Ben. Their hours with Ben: how many diamonds they hold (one diamond = one hour, one to one), their bookings with status (held, confirmed, cancelled) and join link, and the open hours ahead they can book with book_hour_with_ben. And the free 30-minute intro call (introCall): their upcoming one with its join link, or, when they have none, the open times they can book with book_intro_call. Each booking has its `id`, `label`, `canCancel` and `canMove`: cancel one with cancel_booking, move one with move_booking to an open time of the same kind (`openHours` for an hour with Ben, `introCall.moveTimes` for the free intro call). Booking, moving and cancelling happen here; `url` is a page to fall back to only if booking here fails. Each open time has `label` (weekday, date, time and time zone, worked out for the person's time zone, e.g. "Thursday, 17 September · 10:00–10:30 (Berlin time)") and `day`: quote `label` exactly as it is, and never work out a weekday or a date from `start` yourself. Pass `start` exactly as listed to book. `openDays` and `introCall.openDays` group the times by day; `bookableUntil` is the last day the calendar takes bookings for. Pass their time zone to get the times in it. Pass `purpose` when the person wants to book (intro_call or hour_with_ben): the next two weeks are listed, and a chat that can show a time picker shows one.

limit.description: How many open hours, and how many intro-call times, to list.

purpose.description: What the person wants to book right now: intro_call (the free 30-minute call) or hour_with_ben (one diamond). Omit when they only ask about their bookings.

timeZone.description: The person's time zone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Defaults to Berlin.
